changeSet.author: paystack
changeSet.comment: Update Fee Type Breakdown Report to show actual charge names instead of 'OTHER' for unmapped fee types

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT CASE WHEN da.fee_type_category = 'OTHER' OR da.fee_type_category IS NULL THEN COALESCE(da.charge_name, 'Unknown Fee') ELSE da.fee_type_category END AS "Fee Type", COUNT(*) AS "Number of Discounts", SUM(da.original_amount) AS "Total Original Fees", SUM(da.discount_amount) AS "Total Discounts Applied", SUM(da.final_amount) AS "Total Final Fees", ROUND(SUM(da.discount_amount) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(da.original_amount), 0), 2) AS "Discount Percentage", COUNT(DISTINCT da.customer_id) AS "Unique Customers", COUNT(DISTINCT da.account_number) AS "Unique Accounts" FROM v_discount_application_report da WHERE da.application_date::date BETWEEN '${startDate}'::date AND '${endDate}'::date GROUP BY CASE WHEN da.fee_type_category = 'OTHER' OR da.fee_type_category IS NULL THEN COALESCE(da.charge_name, 'Unknown Fee') ELSE da.fee_type_category END ORDER BY SUM(da.discount_amount) DESC
